)

set the filling value

Parameters
model
diverge_model_t*

the model with initialized common internals (diverge_model_internals_common) but without specific ones (via diverge_model_internals_tu, diverge_model_internals_patch, diverge_model_internals_grid)

E
double*

energy array. if (E == NULL) the internal energy array is used and modified. Otherwise, E is used and modified

nb
index_t

number of bands. if (E == NULL) the internal number of bands is used

nu
double

filling value between 0 (all bands empty) and 1 (all bands full)

Returns

the chemical potential used to set the desired filling value
